replication.target_description: Experiment 1, Single fixation duration, word n+2 region, preview effect for low-frequency word n+1 items; both participant groups modeled together. Selected as the counterpart to Yang et al. (2012). Supplied locator does not explicitly distinguish frequency conditions or regions.

n.sample_role: Retained participant groups: 40 native Chinese readers tested in England and 40 in China. Per-test fixation observation counts not reported. Value preserves the two printed group sizes rather than substituting an unprinted total.
n.exclusions: Eighteen additional participants excluded for noticing >3 display changes. Trials with blinks (14%), early display changes (9%), or changes completing >10 ms after fixation onset (4%) removed; total 27% data excluded.

notes: Both retrieved full-text titles and DOIs verified against supplied references. Target ambiguity retained: the input does not specify boundary, target region or frequency condition, so target_match is null. Main n+2/low-frequency target selected from the stated replication of Yang et al. (2012); no n+1 and n+2 statistics are combined. Original p. 1088 also prints b = 17, SE = 8.4, p < .05 for the DIFFERENT boundary-after-n−1 (n+1 preview) test; those coefficients must not be assigned to the n+2 test. Original n+2 coefficient not printed. Original table extraction renders > as [ and < as backslash. Replication Table 3 prints b/SE/t without p values; no p computed. Its lower-frequency section header reads "Word n+2 Low Frequency", but Methods/Results and Table 2 establish that the manipulated frequency is word n+1. Replication accepted-manuscript pagination differs from the supplied p. 9 locator.
